latest_release.body:
v4.0 is arguably Shattered's biggest update yet! There's a massive new quest, a bunch of new in-game art, 6 new enchantments, and plenty smaller changes and adjustments.

---

**Blog posts related to this update:**
- [Shattered Pixel Dungeon v4.0.3!](https://shatteredpixel.com/blog/shattered-pixel-dungeon-v403.html)
- [Shattered Pixel Dungeon v4.0.0!](https://shatteredpixel.com/blog/shattered-pixel-dungeon-v400.html)
- [Coming Soon to Shattered: The Vault Quest!](https://shatteredpixel.com/blog/coming-soon-to-shattered-the-vault-quest.html)
- [Status Update: v4.0 Beta Soon!](https://shatteredpixel.com/blog/status-update-v40-beta-soon.html)
- [Coming Soon to Shattered: New Enchants and Pixel Art!](https://shatteredpixel.com/blog/coming-soon-to-shattered-new-enchants-and-pixel-art.html)
- [Coming Soon to Shattered: A New City Quest!](https://shatteredpixel.com/blog/coming-soon-to-shattered-a-new-city-quest.html)

---

The following builds of Shattered Pixel Dungeon are available for this update:

**Android 5.0(API 21)+ Devices:**
[![Get it on Google Play](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/gplay.png)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shatteredpixel.shatteredpixeldungeon) [![Itch.io](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/itch.png)](https://shattered-pixel.itch.io/shattered-pixel-dungeon)
You can directly download the open-source [Android build](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases/download/v4.0.3/ShatteredPD-v4.0.3-Android.apk) and the [Google Play build](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases/download/v4.0.3/ShatteredPD-v4.0.3-GPlay.apk) from Github.

**iOS 13+ Devices:**
[![Download on the App Store](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/appstore.png)](https://apps.apple.com/app/shattered-pixel-dungeon/id1563121109)
Due to [Apple's Developer Agreements](https://developer.apple.com/support/terms/), I am not currently able to offer a direct download for iOS.

**Computers: (OpenGL 2.0+ GPU)**
[![Steam](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/steam.png)](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769170/Shattered_Pixel_Dungeon/) [![GOG.com](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/gog.png)](https://www.gog.com/game/shattered_pixel_dungeon) [![Itch.io](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/itch.png)](https://shattered-pixel.itch.io/shattered-pixel-dungeon)
You can directly download the open-source [Windows 10+](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases/download/v4.0.3/ShatteredPD-v4.0.3-Windows.zip), [MacOS 10.12+](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases/download/v4.0.3/ShatteredPD-v4.0.3-macOS.zip), and [Linux (glibc 2.17+)](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases/download/v4.0.3/ShatteredPD-v4.0.3-Linux.zip) builds from Github.
There is also an open-source [multi-platform JAR build](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases/download/v4.0.3/ShatteredPD-v4.0.3-Java.jar), which requires a separate installation of Java 11+.

---

v4.0.0 was the last version of Shattered Pixel Dungeon to support iOS 12, due to a new requirement by Apple when uploading to the App Store. iOS 13/14 support will also likely be dropped after v4.1.0 for similar reasons.

detail.readme:
# Shattered Pixel Dungeon [Shattered Pixel Dungeon](https://shatteredpixel.com/shatteredpd/) is an open-source traditional roguelike dungeon crawler with randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collect and use. It's based on the [source code of Pixel Dungeon](https://github.com/00-Evan/pixel-dungeon-gradle), by [Watabou](https://watabou.itch.io/). Shattered Pixel Dungeon currently compiles for Android, iOS, and Desktop platforms. You can find official releases of the game on: [![Get it on Google Play](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/gplay.png)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shatteredpixel.shatteredpixeldungeon) [![Download on the App Store](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/appstore.png)](https://apps.apple.com/app/shattered-pixel-dungeon/id1563121109) [![Steam](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/steam.png)](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769170/Shattered_Pixel_Dungeon/)
[![GOG.com](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/gog.png)](https://www.gog.com/game/shattered_pixel_dungeon) [![Itch.io](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/itch.png)](https://shattered-pixel.itch.io/shattered-pixel-dungeon) [![Github Releases](https://shatteredpixel.com/assets/images/badges/github.png)](https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon/releases) - If you like this game, please consider [supporting me on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/ShatteredPixel)! - There is an official blog for this project at [ShatteredPixel.com](https://www.shatteredpixel.com/blog/). - The game also has a translation project hosted on [Transifex](https://explore.transifex.com/shattered-pixel/shattered-pixel-dungeon/). ## Notes for Developers: (Last Updated November 2026) ### Contributing Thank you for the interest, but **this repository does not accept pull requests!** The code here is provided in hopes that others may find it useful for their own projects, not to allow community contribution. Issue reports of all kinds (bug reports, feature requests, etc.) are welcome. ### Use of Generative AI Shattered Pixel Dungeon is made by humans (me, I'm the human), for humans. Generative AI in its current form is privately owned technology built on mass-theft, which is actively attempting to replace the very people it has stolen from. **This project does not use genAI/LLMs in ANY way.** If you are considering using genAI when making your own Pixel Dungeon version, **DON'T**. If you do use AI, do not message me asking for help, advice, permission, etc. I don't want anything to do with you. ### Documentation If you'd like to work with the code, you can find the following guides in `/docs`: - [Quick Setup (desktop only)](docs/quick-setup.md) - [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md) - [Compiling for Android](docs/compiling-for-android.md) - [Compiling for Desktop Platforms](docs/compiling-for-desktop.md) - [Compiling for iOS](docs/compiling-for-ios.md) - [Recommended changes for making your own version](docs/recommended-changes.md) - **This section has important details If you plan to distribute your PD version on storefronts like Google Play!** Please also feel free to message me if you'd like any help/advice working with the code, or have suggestions for other things you'd like to see explained here! I am actively trying to make Shattered's codebase easier for humans (not AI) to work with, and so I hope to expand these docs soon.
